item.title: [Yoruba · 90s Briefing] From Ephemeral Inference to Compiled Agency
item.description: Àwọn ohun tí a fi hàn nínú àwọn ìṣàmúlò-ètò yìí jẹ́ pé, ìmọ̀rọ̀n kọ́mputa tí o ga jú lọ díẹ̀ nípa gbogbo eniyan lórí bi módèlè̀ àtilẹbá tí a nṣé bí ilé́ rerè tòjú nínú àwọn táàbù lilọ́ọ̀kan, àwọn inídísítà wiwa, atí awọn soluséètì tòjú. Ẹ̀yà kẹtà, ìgbésẹ́ àwọn ẹ̀rọ tí a fi pàdé nínú bíti kan ṣé gba àwọn ẹ̀kọ́, sugboń tí a bá fi wọn pamọ́ padà sí àwọn nọmba pupo-afẹ́fẹ Ninu awọn ohun elo ti o ni ibatan si imọ-ẹrọ, a lo awọn ọna kika data bii awọn aworan, awọn fidio, awọn ọrọ, ati awọn faili lati ṣe agbekalẹ awọn iṣẹ ṣiṣe ti o rọrun. Ninu awọn iṣẹ iṣakoso ti o ni ibatan si ọgọrun-un mẹrinla, wiwa awoṣe-ẹjọ ṣe aṣeyọri awọn ipilẹṣẹ neural nipasẹ awọn ipin ogorun 61.60 lori awọn ọna ẹrọ irinṣẹ ti a ṣe apẹrẹ ati awọn ipin 20.80 lori igbẹkẹle Boolean ni agbara shunt ti o wa titi ti 1.41 si 2.09 microjoules, ni kikun fi idiwọ iyatọ triage ti kodi ti o han gbangba ti awọn aaye 12.80. Ni AMD Kria mẹrin-volt board shunt pẹlu 0.09 si 0.11 ogorun idle drift, unpacking 0.1517 bits-per-weight matricses to 32-bit floats sunmọ 63,335.56 microjoules gross—81.86 igba ti o dara ju awọn integers marun-bit—nigbati packed integer Walsh-Hadamard, exclusive-NOR, bit-count, ati nibble lookup padanu si 187.49 microjoules gross ati 10.30 microjoules net. A hash-verified integer kernel dapọ bit-for-bit lori mẹrinla laini ati mẹta fabrics—processor, Radeon 8060S Vulkan graphic, split processor-graphic, WebAssembly vectors, Verilog hardware logic, ati a 1,444-byte bare-metal microcontroller—ti o ti tu silẹ lori tamper kan-iwuwo ni apapo pẹlu 1,315 Planetary Digital Well mu awọn ilana. Ipari si ipari, awọn mẹrin-ipele spellcheck cascade ku Kria shunt agbara 26.58 igba gross ati 24.49 igba net, ku Jetson Thor shunt agbara 16.26 igba, ati ti yọkuro 38.46 igba ti igbesẹ-mẹta ipe. Gbogbo awọn gbajumọ ni Signed Provenance, Self-Checked—ko si externally peer-reviewed—nikan pẹlu shunt, chip-counter, estimated, ati unmetered joules ti a fipamọ lagbara lati ṣe ni apapọ.
